lines.text: Ahaziah falls through a lattice in Samaria and sends messengers to ask Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, if he will recover.
The messengers return and describe a hairy man with a leather belt, and the king says it was Elijah.
The king sends a captain with fifty men to Elijah on a mountain, and fire from heaven consumes them.

wrong_details.true: sitting on top of a hill

lines.text: A second captain also orders Elijah down and is consumed, and then a third captain begs Elijah on his knees to spare his life.
Elijah goes down with the third captain, tells Ahaziah he will recover, and Jehu becomes king in his place.
